subject: Archaeology
title: Pseudoarchaeology: How to Spot It
description: A 60-second lesson on Pseudoarchaeology: How to Spot It.

hook.text: Lost continents, ancient energy grids, and giant civilizations — pseudoarchaeology thrives because real archaeology.

buildup.text: Pseudoarchaeological claims ignore evidence, cherry-pick data, and present speculation as fact.

discovery.text: Common red flags: unnamed experts, no published research, claims that mainstream science is hiding the truth.

twist.text: Pseudoarchaeology often exploits real gaps in knowledge. Genuine mysteries attract fake explanations because real.

climax.text: The best defense is scientific literacy: checking sources, reading peer-reviewed papers.

punchline.text: If the explanation is exciting and requires no evidence, it is probably wrong.

quiz.question: What is a key red flag of pseudoarchaeological claims?
options: They are published in university journals
They claim mainstream science is hiding the truth and skip peer review
They focus on well-documented periods of history
